checks: Group selected puts both Patterns in the filter group (pattern.group)
Ungroup selected clears only the chosen Pattern
A missing Pattern is refused and nothing changes
Grouping and ungrouping are one Undo step each
Rename / colour names the Pattern (pattern.properties)
A transparent Pattern colour is refused
Rename / colour is one Undo step
The demo Pattern has notes (36)
Transpose moves every note up an octave (pattern.transpose)
A transpose outside MIDI pitches is refused and nothing changes
An empty Pattern has nothing to transpose
Transpose is one Undo step
Clone selected Patterns adds two Patterns (pattern.cloneSelected)
The clones carry the notes
Delete selected Patterns removes them (pattern.deleteSelected)
Delete selected is one Undo step
Delete Patterns not in Playlist keeps only placed Patterns (pattern.deleteUnplaced, 1 left)
Delete Patterns not in Playlist is one Undo step
Delete empty unused Patterns removes the empty unplaced Pattern (pattern.deleteEmpty)
Delete empty unused Patterns is one Undo step
scope: Isolated --mcp-test; the registered operations the Picker Pattern menu runs. Not native popup, confirmation dialog or file dialog input.
